metadata.question: Through the months of December 2018 and January 2019, did sourthern African countries (Namibia, Botswana, Lesotho) recieve less rain than the long-term average for the same two-month period from 2000 to 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use CHIRPS precipitation data (daily, 0.05° resolution) - Compare Dec 2018 + Jan 2019 vs. long-term average for Dec+Jan across 2000-2019 - Region: Namibia, Botswana, Lesotho (southern Africa) 2. Masking strategy: - CHIRPS is precipitation data, no cloud masking needed - Simple summation of rainfall 3. Logic: - Calculate total rainfall for Dec 2018 + Jan 2019 - Calculate average total rainfall for Dec+Jan periods from 2000-2019 (20 years) - Compare: if 2018-2019 < long-term average → A (Yes), else → B (No) - Check for C1 (no data), C2 (no valid pixels), C3 (invalid calculation) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define region (Namibia, Botswana, Lesotho) const namibia = ee.FeatureCollection('USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017') .filter(ee.Filter.eq('country_na', 'Namibia')); const botswana = ee.FeatureCollection('USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017') .filter(ee.Filter.eq('country_na', 'Botswana')); const lesotho = ee.FeatureCollection('USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017') .filter(ee.Filter.eq('country_na', 'Lesotho')); const region = namibia.merge(botswana).merge(lesotho).geometry(); // 2. Get CHIRPS precipitation data const chirps = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY'); // 3. Calculate Dec 2018 + Jan 2019 total rainfall const target = chirps .filter(ee.Filter.date('2018-12-01', '2019-02-01')) .select('precipitation') .sum(); const targetSize = chirps.filter(ee.Filter.date('2018-12-01', '2019-02-01')).size().getInfo(); console.log(`Target period images: ${targetSize}`); if (targetSize === 0) { console.log('No data for Dec 2018 - Jan 2019'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 4. Calculate long-term average for Dec+Jan (2000-2019) const years = ee.List.sequence(2000, 2019); const decJanTotals = ee.ImageCollection.fromImages( years.map(function(year) { const startDate = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 12, 1); const endDate = startDate.advance(2, 'month'); return chirps .filter(ee.Filter.date(startDate, endDate)) .select('precipitation') .sum() .set('year', year); }) ); const longTermSize = decJanTotals.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Long-term period collections: ${longTermSize}`); if (longTermSize === 0) { console.log('No long-term data available'); console.log('C1'); return; } const longTermAvg = decJanTotals.mean(); // 5. Calculate regional statistics const targetStats = target.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: region, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const longTermStats = longTermAvg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: region, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const targetMean = targetStats.get('precipitation_mean').getInfo(); const targetCount = targetStats.get('precipitation_count').getInfo(); const longTermMean = longTermStats.get('precipitation_mean').getInfo(); const longTermCount = longTermStats.get('precipitation_count').getInfo(); console.log(`Target (Dec18-Jan19) mean rainfall: ${targetMean !== null ? targetMean.toFixed(2) : 'null'} mm, pixels: ${targetCount}`); console.log(`Long-term avg (2000-2019) mean rainfall: ${longTermMean !== null ? longTermMean.toFixed(2) : 'null'} mm, pixels: ${longTermCount}`); // 6. Validation if (targetCount === 0 || longTermCount === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels in region'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (targetMean === null || longTermMean === null || isNaN(targetMean) || isNaN(longTermMean) || targetMean < 0 || longTermMean < 0) { console.log('Invalid calculation result'); console.log('C3'); return; } // 7. Final comparison console.log(`Comparison: ${targetMean.toFixed(2)} vs ${longTermMean.toFixed(2)}`); if (targetMean < longTermMean) { console.log('Dec18-Jan19 received LESS rain than long-term average'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Dec18-Jan19 received MORE or EQUAL rain than long-term average'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
